patchHints.zh-CN: 只修改用户要求的教学参数，其余字段保留。
patchHints.en: Patch only the requested teaching parameters and preserve the rest.

patchHints.zh-CN: 天净沙·秋思→autumn-thoughts，登鹳雀楼→stork-tower，静夜思→quiet-night。补全/归类练习不改写原文。只支持这三首内置文本，其他诗文用文本细读或其他可信渲染器；不能虚构朗读能力。
patchHints.en: Map Tianjingsha to autumn-thoughts, Stork Tower to stork-tower and Quiet Night to quiet-night. Keep original wording. Practice and word selection are local state. Other texts should use close reading or another trusted renderer.

fallbackConditions.zh-CN: 本组件不处理：其他诗词的自动编写与仿作、音频朗读、视频与自动播放、任意文本输入、单一标准文学解读、audio recitation、arbitrary poems or prose、one uniquely correct literary interpretation。
fallbackConditions.en: Automatic composition or arbitrary poems/prose, audio recitation, video, autoplay or a claim of one uniquely correct literary interpretation.

examplePrompts.zh-CN: 天净沙秋思的景物为什么显得凄凉？把原句和画面对应起来
examplePrompts.en: Connect the images in Autumn Thoughts to their words and explain the reading.

examplePrompts.zh-CN: 静夜思写地上霜，是不是真的结霜了？
examplePrompts.en: Does the frost comparison in Thoughts on a Quiet Night establish that it really froze?
